verdict.rationale: Convex documents a Custom Auth Integration that accepts tokens from any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider, which covers OIDC-based enterprise SSO at the token-acceptance level. It also documents integrations with third-party auth providers, including WorkOS AuthKit, described as built for B2B apps. Convex Auth itself only lists social providers, one-time codes and passwords, and nothing in the evidence shows Convex itself enforcing MFA or supporting SAML. missing for 10: documented MFA requirement or enforcement, SAML support, any policy to require SSO or MFA for application users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can require MFA and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) for my application users

citations.quote: Custom Auth Integration allow any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider to be used for authentication
WorkOS AuthKit is built for B2B apps
helps you build a custom sign-up/sign-in flow via social identity providers, one-time email or SMS access codes, or via passwords.
